validation_source_name: City of Fort Worth Open Data - CFW Police Crime Data Points
worker_judgment_notes: Selected the current official City of Fort Worth ArcGIS feature layer because it is a runnable point feed with epoch-ms Reported_Date, offense code and description fields, Case_No_Offense identity, and ArcGIS point geometry. The old Socrata k6ic-7kp7 path now redirects to the ArcGIS Hub/legacy path, so the ArcGIS service is the current runnable feed. This is share-lane only: raw feed counts must not be treated as annual control totals. The police Crime Data Center notes that certain crimes, including most sexually oriented offenses and juvenile-related cases, are not mapped; the ArcGIS item description also says juvenile-related data is removed and locations are generalized to the hundred block. Rape is therefore intentionally omitted because no defensible mapped 11A/rape category was present in the inspected 2024 offense codes. Offense mapping uses NIBRS-style Offense codes: 09A murder/nonnegligent manslaughter, 120 robbery, 13A aggravated assault, 220 burglary, 23A-23H larceny-theft, and 240 motor vehicle theft. Identity uses Case_No_Offense; date uses Reported_Date; geography uses runner-provided __arcgis_latitude/__arcgis_longitude from returned geometry. Bounds come from the repo Fort Worth municipal block-group crosswalk/TIGER geometry for jurisdiction 48:municipal:place:4827000 with a small padding for generalized points.
